items.title: Try a 10 to 20 minute walk after dinner
items.text: Taking a walk after a meal went with a rise about 3.2 mg/dL smaller in real adults. In the synthetic program, a walk after dinner went with a rise about 18.3 mg/dL smaller.

items.title: Keep dinner early
items.text: Only 7.7% of your dinners started at 8 pm or later, which is a good thing since sugar rose about 9.2 mg/dL more after late dinners. Keep having most of your dinners before 8 pm.

items.title: Aim for a 13-hour overnight break
items.text: Your overnight fast averaged 12.1 hours, which is a good start. Adding an overnight fast to coaching changed HbA1c by -0.03 points compared with coaching alone in the randomized program.
